# `mise cache`

- **Usage:** `mise cache [SUBCOMMAND]`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/cache/mod.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/cache/mod.rs)

Manage the mise cache

The cache holds data mise can fetch or rebuild again, such as version lists and
release metadata. With no subcommand, prints the cache directory, like
`mise cache path`. See <https://mise.jdx.dev/cache-behavior.html>.

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Subcommands

- [`mise cache clear [--task <TASK>] [TOOL]…`](/cli/cache/clear.html)
- [`mise cache path`](/cli/cache/path.html)
- [`mise cache prune [-v --verbose] [--dry-run] [TOOL]…`](/cli/cache/prune.html)
- [`mise cache task [-J --json] <TASK>`](/cli/cache/task.html)
